summary: Draft summary: As a user, I want to register for an account so that I can access premium content.
assumptions: No major ambiguity detected in draft input; verify all acceptance criteria are complete.

bddScenarios.title: Create account with valid data
bddScenarios.text:
Given a new user with valid registration details
When the user submits the registration form
Then the account is created and a confirmation message appears.

bddScenarios.title: Attempt registration with invalid email
bddScenarios.text:
Given a new user with an improperly formatted email address
When the user submits the registration form
Then validation rejects the email and shows an error message.

bddScenarios.title: Register with missing required fields
bddScenarios.text:
Given a new user with missing required fields
When the user submits the registration form
Then the submission is blocked and required field errors are displayed.

bddScenarios.title: Duplicate account prevention
bddScenarios.text:
Given an email address already registered
When the user attempts to register again
Then the system prevents duplicate accounts and prompts the user appropriately.

bddScenarios.title: Password boundary validation
bddScenarios.text:
Given a password shorter than the minimum length
When the user enters the password
Then the system shows a password length validation message.

bddScenarios.title: User sees success notification
bddScenarios.text:
Given a successful registration submission
When the account is created
Then the user sees a success notification and next steps guidance.

testCases.description: Register with valid data and verify account creation.
Verify error messages for invalid email format.
Ensure missing required fields prevent registration.
Check password minimum length and maximum length validation.
Confirm previously fixed duplicate registration bug remains resolved.
Validate registration form behavior on desktop and mobile browsers.
Explore edge cases around optional fields and UI error handling.
Verify screen reader labels and keyboard navigation on registration form.
Validate backend registration API response codes for valid and invalid payloads.
Check that password fields are masked and not returned in API responses.
Ensure unique email constraint is enforced by the system.
Confirm success guidance is clear after account creation.
